hardware: one Kaggle runtime with two T4s
refresh_policy: renewable weekly; re-read provider quota at each runtime start
reservation_policy: Use the provider remaining allowance and explicit current-week reservations. Do not count the same job once as a local cap and again as a provider reservation. An unallocated test is conservatively reserved in the present week; query again if it starts after a reset.
physical_gpu_hour_counters: diagnostic only; not the Kaggle runtime allowance
overhead_note: This allowance is already included in pretraining-time-scenarios.json; do not add it a second time or above the weekly quota. It is not a measured cost.
